source: probes/capybara-v1 on Station-house/marin-32b-neuron-atlas @ 6402b9e; dense MLP act = silu(gate)*up
fit_data: 20 pair templates x 10 animals x 2 sites (word_last, next) = 400 tokens; all templates, no held-out split
score: side x = pole * act; z_k = (x_k - mu_k) / sd_k; score = (bias + sum_k weights_k * z_k - neg_mean) / neg_sd. For kind raw, score = (x - neg_mean) / neg_sd with mu 0, sd 1, weight 1.
note: fit_margin_* are in-sample margins on the fit data (rival-SD units), for sanity only; they are not held-out results.

random_sets.source: 1,920 random neurons extracted by coalition_extract.py (30 per layer, all 64 layers, default_rng(20261110)); pole oriented by sign of capybara minus rival mean at word_last over all 20 templates
